'''Jon Franke''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 1999 Tucson tournament]] on 31 July 1999 with Troopers, according to Josh Latneau's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d4">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-11-things-for-thinkers-tucson-arizona-7-31-99d4/ things-for-thinkers-tucson-arizona-7-31-99], DeckTech (Josh "Momaw Nadon" Latneau, 11 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-11-things-for-thinkers-tucson-arizona-7-31-99d4/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
